subject.title: Docs landing page: stale brand hero, missing fourth quick-start card, fallback card icons

question: Should maintainers accept the paired docs branding refresh in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102880 and the docs-shell icon renderer in https://github.com/openclaw/docs/pull/96 as the intended current-brand direction?
rationale: The issue has a protected maintainer label and describes brand/product presentation rather than a narrow broken runtime contract, so ClawSweeper should not close or independently implement it without maintainer review of the open PRs.

options.title: Review paired PRs
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the source-docs refresh and docs-shell icon renderer as one visible docs update.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Ask the PRs to split brand assets, quick-start card layout, and shell icon resolution if maintainers want separate review or rollout.

options.title: Reject current direction
options.body: Close or retitle the work only if maintainers decide the current-brand asset direction or lucide shell renderer is not desired.

recommendation.title: Review paired PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the source-docs refresh and docs-shell icon renderer as one visible docs update.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` authored the issue and both open candidate PRs, and the current landing-page source also traces to his recent docs/onboarding commit.
